title: Brand Pattern
rules_text: Embermaw stops trying to kill the front line in one blow and starts making it easier to kill later. Nothing this Round is lethal; everything this Round is permanent.

instant_beats.title: Searing Brand
instant_beats.rules_text: Embermaw marks the guardian with a Sear, reach 3. Each Sear that Hero carries makes every blow they take land 1 harder, and a Sear does not fade on its own. Armor answers the blow; it does not answer the mark.

incoming_beats.title: Test the Brand
incoming_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank, within 1 hex. Deal 4 damage, plus 1 for each Sear that Hero carries.
